title: ChatHealthy Build Record
description: The form of the record a build writes beside the bytes it produced, and the deploy reads. It carries only what a build knows and the deployment record cannot: which build this is, which commit it came from, and the measured hashes of what was packaged. It carries no copy of the deployment record. A build writes one of these per package it built, and one for a target built without naming a package; the per-package form additionally carries package_id, digest and content_hashes.

$schema.description: The URI of this schema, so a reader can resolve the form of what it is holding.

build_number.description: The build counter at the moment this build ran. A build number cannot be declared before the build that mints it, which is why it is recorded here and not declared.

build_sha.description: Short git SHA of HEAD when the build ran. Pins the source the bytes were produced from.

target_id.description: The deployment target these bytes were built for.

architecture_sha256.description: Hash of the deployment record this build read its instructions from. A deploy re-reads that record and refuses when the hash has moved, so a record edited between build and deploy cannot pass unnoticed.

package_id.description: The package these bytes compose. Present on a per-package record, absent on a target record.

digest.description: One hash over every byte the package carries, each file hashed with its package-relative path in sorted order, line endings normalised. Answers whether this package is the one that was built.

content_hashes.description: The hash of each file the package carries, keyed by its package-relative path, line endings normalised. Answers which file moved, which a single digest cannot. This is the build stating what it measured; it is never written back into the deployment record the build reads.

env.description: The environment this build was made for.

git_head_sha.description: Short git SHA of HEAD, as the deploy gate reads it.

build.description: The build number as the deploy gate reads it.

built_at.description: When the build ran, in UTC.
